name: Biological and Biomedical Sciences (BBS) PhD
summary: Harvard Medical School's umbrella PhD program in biological and biomedical sciences, admitted through Harvard's Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The page lists December 1 at 5:00 PM EST for the Fall 2027 application.

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations go out in mid-December. Interview weekends are January 21–24 and February 4–7, 2027.
timeline.decisions: Admit and waitlist offers go out in mid-February. Admitted Students' Day is March 26, 2027, and the decision deadline is April 15.

english.toefl: 5 overall, Speaking 4.5 (tests from 21 Jan 2026); 100 overall, Speaking 23 (earlier tests)
english.note: IELTS Speaking minimum 6.5. Not needed with an undergraduate degree from an institution where English is the main language of instruction (graduate degrees do not count).

applicationFee.note: Waiver eligibility is checked by questions inside the application; the program cannot authorise waivers directly.

requirements.note: There is no fixed GPA cutoff; review is holistic. Contacting faculty before applying is not expected.

funding.note: Students, regardless of citizenship, receive a comprehensive financial aid package.

international.note: International applicants are reviewed in a single pool with no cap or quota.
